text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali sends condolences message to King Fahd after the Mena fire.
- President orders the implementation of several health, leisure and job-creation measures to help the poor.
- Works to demolish remains of polluting chemical factory called NPK started on Wednesday near the southern city of Sfax.
- Tunisia calls for boosting partnership at the Malta Euro-Mediterranean forum and expresses its concern over the situation in the Middle East.
